rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value:
AM5, compatible with Ryzen 7000/8000/9000 series processors
TDP: 105-180W

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
2 DIMM DDR5 slots, supporting up to 96GB
Dual-channel support
Frequency Support: 4800/5200/5600(OC)/6000(OC)/6200(OC)/6400(OC)/6600(OC)/6800(OC)/7000(OC)/7200(OC)/7400(OC)/7600(OC)/7800(OC)/8000(OC) MHz

rows.label: Display
rows.value:
1 x HDMI 1.4 (up to 4096 x 2160 @ 30Hz)
1 x DisplayPort (up to 4096 x 2160 @ 60Hz)

rows.label: Network
rows.value:
Integrated Realtek 8125BG/D LAN chip
Onboard Realtek 8852BE WiFi 6 with Bluetooth 5.2
1 x onboard M.2 E-Key PCI-E 2230 slot for WiFi

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
2 x M.2 slots (supporting 2242/2280 PCIe 4.0 x4/x2 SSDs)
2 x SATA 3.0 ports

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
Rear I/O: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, 4 x USB 2.0
Internal Headers: 1 x USB 2.0 header (supports 2 ports), 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header (supports 2 ports), 1 x USB Type-C 10G port

rows.label: Additional Features
rows.value:
1 x 24-PIN ATX power connector
RGB Headers: 2 x 5V ARGB headers, 1 x 12V RGB header with MAXSUN Sync support
1 x 8-PIN ATX12V power connector (12V input)
Fan Headers: 2 system fan headers, 1 CPU fan header
1 x COM A header
1 x Rear CLR_CMOS button
1 x TPM header
